title: Upit Global Configuration
description: The Global Configuration selects defaults for one Configuration Set. Runtime validation also enforces usable printable names and cross-document references.

version.description: The supported Global Configuration version. Upit does not migrate other versions.

defaultUploader.description: A case-sensitive Uploader name. Runtime validation requires printable Unicode without leading or trailing Unicode whitespace and a matching Uploader definition.

defaultShortener.description: An optional case-sensitive Shortener name. The empty string clears the selection; runtime validation checks the optional-document matrix and matching definition.
